summary: The KayKit small barrel matches the brief's shape, scale and budget and has no visible holes, but one palette assertion fails: Wet Slate before correction is 22.3 against a limit of 20. The failure looks misleading, and whether the hoops should be dark iron rather than mid grey is a palette call for the user.

findings.observation: The kit's hoops are cool blue-grey (#96A2A7, 45% of the footprint), 22.3 dE from Wet Slate before correction (limit 20); after correction #89827D at 9.1 dE passes, and they still read as plain grey metal bands.
findings.evidence: assertion 'palette color Wet Slate close before correction'; 01_front.png, 04_top.png

findings.observation: Prompt asks for dark iron hoops; they render mid warm grey (grouped under Wet Slate, not Blackened Iron).

questions_answered: 1.0 x 1.0 x 1.02 m barrel with brown staves and two hoops; hoops mid grey.
Two parts; bung's loop not visible.
Barrow Oak passes; Wet Slate fails before (22.3) and passes after (9.1).
escalation_reason: Only the before-correction Wet Slate assertion fails (22.3 > 20) and the views show it is misleading. No revise action fits a sourced kit piece; the user decides (1) whether to accept the before-correction miss for this kit colour and (2) whether hoops stay mid warm grey or group toward Blackened Iron.
